trigger_phrase_or_event: creator asked to create illustrations with exact text, fresh camera angles, non-repeating clothes, and mostly POV/side/back shots

copy_lock.copy: When I say I want to do life with you, I mean:
I want to take turns brewing coffee every morning.
I want to make grocery lists with you every week.

I want to wander aimlessly
through farmers’ markets with you.
I want to wash the dishes while you dry them.

I want to slow dance in the kitchen,
just because.

I want to fold laundry while we
toss socks at each other.

visual_format_anthropologist.extract: Borrow only the mechanic: exact ordinary-life declarations paired with intimate daily scenes.

scene_evidence_director.requirement: Every slide must include visible action through hands, body distance, object movement, or partner response.

romance_blocking_director.requirement: Aachu and Zuv remain active even when faces are hidden.

typography_and_aspect_director.requirement: Exact text in clean upper-middle negative space for native 4:5 and native 9:16.

generation_prompt_director.requirement: Use identity and style reference images as actual inputs before generation.

harsh_visual_selector.repair: Block full batch if text is wrong, paper turns yellow, hands/anatomy are broken, or the image looks like a copied screenshot.
